uncertain: total_required_credits (20.0) records only the common core (pre-requisite plus 4 required blocks). The program consists of the common core plus Track Study: students follow exactly one of the mutually exclusive tracks; summing all groups would double-count tracks. The additional credits per track are approximately: Applied Mathematics +33, Computer Science +40, Financial and Actuarial Mathematics +43, General Mathematics +24, IRE +33 (includes 27-34 'Other(s)'), Pure Mathematics (Advanced) +30, Pure Mathematics +29, Statistics +34.

Several blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. MATH 2023/2024, 2033/2043, 2121/2131, 3033/3043, capstone alternatives), and several alternatives carry track restrictions, so actual credits may differ.

Several elective groups (e.g. MATH 3000-level or above Elective, COMP 4000-level or above Elective, General Mathematics Track electives) do not have specific course lists in the PDF ('Any course(s) of the subject and level as specified'), so their courses arrays are empty.
Remarks in the PDF note that MATH 4333 was last offered in 2020-21 and deleted subsequently; it is kept in the list as printed in the PDF.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 MATH (4Y) (2025-26 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2025-26 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2025-26 per the intake year.
